posts.title: Learning MegaGem, from self-play to price discovery
posts.description: We study MegaGem, a multi-player, general-sum, imperfect-information auction game developed by Jane Street, and train Qwen3-4B-Instruct to play it. SFT raises it’s elo rating from 551 to 1158, ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.8, and GPT-5.5.
